summary: Falcon's Beyond Global, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce the timing and terms of its regular quarterly dividend on its 11% Series B Cumulative Convertible Preferred Stock. The dividend accrues at 11% of the $5.00 liquidation preference and, prior to January 1, 2027, will be paid in additional shares of Series B Preferred Stock (PIK). Record date is September 16, 2026; payment date is October 1, 2026, at $0.137123 per share, or approximately 0.027 PIK shares per existing share, with cash for fractional shares. This is a routine dividend announcement, not a special situation.
